Project.name: Munisiyah - Terrain After + complete native softscape CAD companion

Application.name: OpenAI Terrain Reconstruction
Application.desc: Terrain After TIN preserved unchanged. Companion Muanisiyah_ALL_CAD_OBJECTS.geojson represents all 4456 modelspace objects from Muanisiyah_SHRUBS_GROUNDCOVER(1).dxf, including planting surfaces, flower-bed boundaries, planting grid, individual shrub inserts, planting callout symbols, MULTILEADER callout text and leader lines. Trees Xref XREF_MON_SFT_TREES.dwg was additionally reconciled to the companion GeoJSON: 766 CAD tree inserts matched to existing tree points, with CAD block/layer/ID/rotation/scale/species metadata retained; 123 existing GIS tree points are preserved as GIS-only records. No tree Z/elevation was invented in LandXML.

Surface.name: Munisiyah_Proposed_Terrain
Surface.desc: Terrain After TIN preserved unchanged. Complete plan/annotation CAD companion data is stored in Muanisiyah_ALL_CAD_OBJECTS.geojson; no CAD annotation Z values were invented. Tree geometry remains in the GeoJSON companion; the Terrain After TIN is unchanged.
